source_boundaries: The supplied backend file is an implementation-ready JSON specification, not executable Kotlin backend source.
The Jetpack package supplies a presentation port plus deterministic preview backend; it does not fabricate the production Room/scheduler/timer/AdMob/UMP/Play Billing implementation.

The SwiftUI package mirrors the app-owned UI/workflow contract but does not invent iOS share ingress, StoreKit products, AdMob iOS behavior, or Apple background behavior absent from the authoritative Android backend.
For ad layout, the app-specific backend rule reserveLayoutSpaceOnlyWhenAdLoaded=true overrides the general shell loading-reservation default; the skin collapses the rail until loaded.
